user.title: NEC phone system
user.description: Connects to the SMDR (call log) port of an NEC SL2100 or SV9100. The port is set in Program 10-20 (external equipment 5, SMDR Output); 4001 is the Australian default.

data_description.host: IP address of the phone system's NET port, e.g. 192.168.0.10.
data_description.port: Program 10-20, type 5. Only one program can hold this port at a time.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to FreePBX again
reauth_confirm.description: FreePBX at {host} rejected the manager login, so live calls and do-not-disturb have stopped. The call log still works. Enter the manager user and password (FreePBX: Settings > Asterisk Manager Users).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, that SMDR output is set to LAN (Program 35-01-01) and that no other call logger is connected.
error.ami_auth: FreePBX rejected that manager user or password.
error.ami_cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the FreePBX manager at that address and port. Check the address, and that this Home Assistant is allowed under the manager user's Permit.

abort.already_configured: This phone system is already set up.

init.title: Rooms, lines, phonebook, FreePBX and AI attendant
init.description: One entry per line as `number: name`. Each extension and line listed gets its own device. The FreePBX fields are optional: fill them in to see calls ringing live and to switch do-not-disturb. The AI attendant fields are optional too: fill them in only if you run the separate nec-ai-attendant engine.

data.date_order: Date order in the call log

data_description.phonebook: For example `0491570156: Alex`. Used to put names on calls.
data_description.date_order: How your phone system prints dates. Automatic works it out from each call; pick one if your dates look wrong.
data_description.lines: Trunk number to name, for example `001: Main line`. Shown on the call log as the line number.
data_description.ami_host: Optional. The FreePBX IP address, for live ringing and caller ID. Leave empty to turn it off.
data_description.ami_user: A manager user from FreePBX: Settings > Asterisk Manager Users. It needs read access to call and system, and write access to system for do-not-disturb.
data_description.ami_secret: That manager user's password. Leave it empty to keep the saved one.
data_description.dnd_extensions: FreePBX extensions that get a do-not-disturb switch, comma separated, for example `901, 902`. An extension also listed above gets the switch on its own device.
data_description.phonebook_todo: Optional. A Home Assistant to-do list used as a phonebook, so you can add contacts from the phone app: one item per person with their number in the description (or "Alex 0491 570 156" as the item). The phonebook above wins for the same number.
data_description.missed_todo: Optional. A Home Assistant to-do list that gets an item for each missed call, such as "Call back 0491570156 (Alex) missed 3:42 pm at Reception". It is ticked off by itself when someone calls that number back.
data_description.attendant_url: Optional. The address of your nec-ai-attendant engine, for example `http://192.0.2.20:8099`. Leave it empty to turn the AI attendant off.
data_description.attendant_token: The engine's `api_token`. Leave it empty to keep the saved one.

error.bad_mapping: Every line needs a colon, like `103: Oliver`.
error.ami_auth: FreePBX rejected that manager user or password.
error.ami_cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the FreePBX manager at that address and port. Check the address, and that this Home Assistant is allowed under the manager user's Permit.
error.attendant_bad_url: Enter the address with http:// or https://, like `http://192.0.2.20:8099`.
error.attendant_cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the AI attendant at that address, or it didn't answer like one. Check the address and port (8099 by default), and that the engine is running.
error.attendant_auth: The AI attendant rejected that API token.

call_log_unreachable.title: {name}: call log not connected
call_log_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant hasn't been able to read the call log from the phone system at {address} for over 10 minutes (last error: {error}).

Calls made in the meantime aren't lost: the phone system keeps them and sends them when the connection comes back. Check that the phone system is on, that its address hasn't changed, and that no other program (such as call-logging software) is connected to the SMDR port. This message clears itself once the call log reconnects.

attendant_auth.title: {name}: AI attendant token rejected
attendant_auth.description:
The AI attendant at {url} rejected the API token, so its entities are unavailable. The phone system's call log still works.

Open **Configure** on the NEC PBX integration and enter the engine's current `api_token`. This message clears itself once the engine accepts it.

save_caller.name: Save caller to phonebook
save_caller.description: Adds a name and number to the phonebook list (or the phonebook in the options if there is no list). Without a number, it saves the last incoming caller.

number.name: Number
number.description: Leave empty to save the last incoming caller.

config_entry_id.name: Phone system
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

attendant_mark_message_done.name: Mark AI attendant message done
attendant_mark_message_done.description: Marks a message the AI attendant took as done, so it leaves the New messages sensor.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: The `id` of the message, from the New messages sensor's `messages` attribute.

config_entry_id.name: Phone system
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.

attendant_set_answering.name: Set AI attendant answering
attendant_set_answering.description: Turns answering of outside calls by the AI attendant on or off, like the Answer outside calls switch.

enabled.name: Answer outside calls
enabled.description: On: the AI attendant answers outside calls. Off: they ring as normal.

config_entry_id.name: Phone system
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if you have more than one.
